what_this_proves: a sandboxed session receives the hook's environment variables, and the static mapping in the store aoe seeds reads one, so the tag travels without a config copy; the copy the plugin writes is under the app dir, which aoe does not mount, so an overlay_env pointing there is a path the harness cannot read — `real_session` shows that on a host whose before_start line predates `--substrate`, and `real_session.plugin_sandbox_hook` shows the shipped sandbox line exporting the same payload with no overlay env and no app dir at all
